name: Black Mountain 10 Minute Oil
hours: Mon 9 AM–5 PM; Tue 9 AM–5 PM; Wed 9 AM–5 PM; Thu 9 AM–5 PM; Fri 9 AM–5 PM; Sat Closed; Sun Closed

reviews.t: Do not take your car here. While one of the men working here is nice, the other is so extremely rude and can not be trusted to do honest work. Took our healthy 2015 Chevy equinox in for an oil change and a few weeks later she won’t start. Absolutely no oil in it and totaled our engine. No leak in the tank. Unbelievably sad that they are just throwing cars back out on the road with no intention of being safe. Please read down more, we are not the first customers for this to happen too.
Been here a few times for oil changes/ inspections. Always courteous & timely, really clean shop & waiting room. Good prices.
They were very fast and thorough. One of the workers wasn't very pleasant. Not rude - let's just say he was a little short on customer skills
Love reading their plaques while waiting to have car inspection or oil change done. Had to visit the restroom today and what do you know, they have them in there to.
Absolutely love this place! These guys are awesome, & the service is always great & quick! Highly recommend!

I pulled in with my car and the mechanic greeted me immediately. We brought our other car here as well and they do a great and quick job!! We appreciate all the hard workers here. The prices are fair and not overpriced. We got an oil change and inspection, both done within 15 minutes. Thank you guys!!!
Grate service best price and always fast and professional I never take my car anywhere else

I'm grateful that I can have my car serviced quickly and correctly without breaking the bank. I do quite a bit of traveling and my home town guys are much more expensive and their hours are not as convenient for my work schedule. So when traveling like I do, it's great to have found a business that I can trust and depend on to service my car without any hassle! Glad I found you guys!

after taking several vehicles here, i do not recommend any services performed at this location. car 1) had taken in for an oil change 3x and neither time did they replace the factory oil filter car 2) took it in for an oil change, no notes of leaks, but a day or 2 later an oil leak started, keep in mind my driveway was spotless car 3) i didn’t get the chance to have this car serviced, but i was lied to about wait times, said it would be an hour and half before they got me in. little did i notice they closed in just that time. neither 2 of my vehicles had a proper service complete, let alone did anyone write my mileage correctly on a sticker to inform me of my next oil change. i’m not a stickler for bad reviews, but this is NOT a creditable location to take your car to.

Such a great experience! Went real quick before driving back to Charlotte. They got me right in. I had my little dog with me and they were so sweet and inviting to him too! Very hard working, highly recommend!
